question: Which Hollywood couple just quietly ended their marriage?
story: Margaret Qualley and Jack Antonoff just quietly ended their marriage, and Taylor Swift had a front row seat to the whole thing. If the names do not click, the faces will. Qualley is the actress from Poor Things and The Substance. Antonoff is the Grammy winning producer behind half the pop songs you love, and Taylor Swift's longtime collaborator. According to multiple outlets, the two have separated after less than three years of marriage. They first sparked romance back in 2021, went public in 2022, then married in New Jersey in the summer of 2023, with Swift herself reportedly among the guests. This month, Qualley made her first public appearance since the split news broke, spotted on the set of a new horror film. Neither has said much, and she has reportedly brushed off the swirling speculation. Two years ago she called him her person. This summer, the story quietly changed.
